brief: owner brief 2026-10-08 item 1 — v3.1 gate patterns (fabrication.py) + corpus recompute
method: deterministic regex scan of PUBLISHED article BODIES (frontmatter excluded); fabrication_gate scan semantics (case-insensitive except certified); v3_1_cta_tested requires a CTA cue line, v3_1_studies_shown requires a ratio and no same-sentence link; no model calls

s1_v3_1 special scanners.v3_1_cta_tested: line matches /tested (extensions|chrome|guides)/ AND a CTA cue (library of | browse our | check out | explore our | visit our | collection of)
s1_v3_1 special scanners.v3_1_studies_shown: sentence matches 'Studies (have) shown' + a percentage, with no source link in the same sentence; blockquote+link excused; table/heading lines skipped
